intro.title: Red Carnelian Stone
intro.descriptionHtml: Carnelian is a red and reddish orange crystal that has delighted people since the days of the ancient Egyptian Pharaohs. Carnelian is sometimes classified as a Chalcedony, particularly when it has a solid orange hue, and sometimes as an Agate, particularly when it has white stripes. It possesses a joyful energy that can be either playful or protective. It is an excellent housewarming gift, as its energy helps transform a house into a home.

tabs.tab1_description:
Carnelian gemstone is said to be a stone for boosting self-confidence in performers, be it performing on a stage in front of an audience or the simple performances of tasks/chores at home. Dark Red Carnelian properties include fertility, which means, Red Carnelian is used for improving fertility in both males and females and also supports childbirth, which is one of its beliefs.

Red Carnelian properties hold importance in its meaning. It is considered a stone of good luck and hope and has been used by famous Historical figures like Napoleon, who wore a Red Carnelian studded watch as a lucky charm. The Red Carnelian is popularly worn by athletes even today for energy, strength, vitality. Reputed as a stone that provides the courage and boosts confidence to take the leap of faith, this powerful stone urges one to take the risk with confidence and move beyond the self-created boundaries.

The warm Red Carnelian stone stands for male energy. Its color is a color of power which is a dark Red Carnelian meaning for which it is worn. Important Red Carnelian properties stand for leadership qualities, motivation, and tolerance. Red Carnelian Agate/ Dark Red Carnelian gemstone is popular for its significant meaning in passion, desire and love, as its fire energy stands for passion.

Carnelian is brimming with vitality, stimulating metabolism and a healthy blood supply to the organs and tissues. It affects the reproductive organs of both sexes and increases fertility, thus overcoming impotence and frigidity. In addition, it alleviates menstrual symptoms and may aid in vitro fertilization and artificial insemination. It assists in the treatment of lower back pain, rheumatism, arthritis, neuralgia, and accelerates the recovery of bones and ligaments. It aids in the relief of depression, particularly in the elderly. It provides excellent support for detoxing from alcohol or other drugs, tearing bad physical habits, and generally improving health.

Carnelian is a stabilizing crystal that is ideal for grounding oneself in the present. Its high energy restores lost vitality and motivation and inspires new creative endeavors. It improves concentration and eliminates unnecessary thoughts in daydreamers and meditators. The gemstone also protects against your own or others' envy, rage, and resentment, and promotes a love of life. It aids in overcoming all forms of abuse by fostering self-confidence and perception.

Carnelian reduces possessiveness and jealousy in relationships and aids in beating sexual fears and eating disorders. Carnelian is a crystal of action, conquering indecision and procrastination. It encourages one to cease waiting for dreams to materialize and instills the courage to accept change and Divine Will in order to begin achieving one's loftiest goals.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Carnelian gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Carnelian. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Root Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Red Carnelian stone is a professional support crystal that assists architects, builders, and construction workers in the creation of master structures, promotes power and stamina in athletes and military members, establishes a framework and structure and stimulates motivation in journalists and salespeople.

Carnelian is believed to attract wealth, fresh resources, and good fortune. It is a talisman for financial success in any endeavor. In the workplace, it is a crystal of ambition, drive, and determination that deflects pressure from coworkers or impersonal corporations with unreasonable expectations.

 

 

Important Details: 

 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Carnelian gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Carnelian gemstones.

Carnelian Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Brazil, Germany, India and parts of Russia are the biggest producers of the Red Carnelian Gemstones.

Observe their Color:

Carnelian is available in a range of red to orange tones, from faint to vibrant.

Notice their Clarity:

Carnelian is nearly always translucent, but can occasionally be opaque. It has a vitreous to waxy sheen, which gives the stone an attractive appearance. Carnelian's luster brings out the stone's color and makes you want to touch the stone's smooth surface.

Examine their Inclusions:

While generally devoid of inclusions, the stone may have a cloudy appearance. If you hold a light up to a carnelian, you will notice that the stone's transparency is uneven, with some areas appearing cloudier than others.

See their Shape:

Carnelian gemstones are commonly cut into seamless cuts, beads, or cabochons to highlight their luster and color. It can, however, be cut into faceted shapes such as round, oval, square, and rectangular.

Check the Carats:

For Carnelian of gem quality, the raw Carnelian is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Carnelian weighing at least 9 carats and above are appropriate for jewelry. Because Carnelian is sold by weight, Carnelian prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Carnelian has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Carnelian

Due to treatments the Carnelian stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Carnelian do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Carnelian gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Carnelian are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Carnelian from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Carnelian gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

Hold the Carnelian in your hand and Chant the Carnelian gemstone Mantra:

Om Bhaum Bhaumaya Namah || ॐभौम भौमाय नम || 108 times.

While chanting the mantra you can visualize white color positive energy surrounding your Carnelian and restoring its powers.

Other Mantras of Lord Mangal (Mars) you can chant are mentioned below

Vedic Stotra Mantra for Mangal Planet

You can choose to reenergize the Carnelian on a Tuesday.

How to check if Carnelian suits you?

Preferably, a powerful gemstone such as Carnelian should only be worn after consultation with an RRCT specialist. Nevertheless, it will be appropriate if worn according to RRCT, and we will add bhasm and energize it for only positive effects.

You can also give yourself at least 72 hours after embracing a Carnelian to determine whether or not you are experiencing any negative effects. If after 72 hours of embracing the Carnelian stone you do not feel even the slightest effect, you are safe to use Carnelian, as this shows it is safe and sure for you and it will not negatively affect you in any way.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Carnelian is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life. Carnelian has been considered a gemstone of luck and prosperity for centuries.

How to know if Carnelian is working?

Within 10 days of wearing, you should begin to experience a sense of increased stability and resolve toward achieving your objectives. The wearer of red carnelian notices both the physical and mental strength and motivation to keep going and move on to new horizons and goals as a result of the red carnelian's ability to give persistence and awaken even the gloomiest spirit. Both sluggishness and procrastination are likely to disappear. If you feel that new vitality has been infused into your life, you may be experiencing a physical, mental, emotional and spiritual awakening and the red carnelian gemstone you have been wearing is working for you.

How long do the effects of Carnelian last?

If cared for properly, a Carnelian can be worn as jewelry for generations. You must wear it until your chakras are balanced. Typically, experts advise wearing gemstones for four years, after which they are no longer necessary.
tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Carnelian gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Carnelian is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality red carnelian shows an intense red color.

Cut

Best quality Carnelian stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Carnelian of 9 carats and above is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Carnelian are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Carnelian rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

A high-quality carnelian gemstone will have a beautiful shape, its surface will reflect light quite effectively, and it can be used as a gemstone for jewelry or as a beautiful ornament.

Traders deal in Carnelian stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Carnelian Gemstone Price

The carnelian stone price depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. This is an affordable gemstone but make sure to procure it untreated.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Carnelian has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Carnelian stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated red Carnelian gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 315 to INR 4,262 (USD 3.94 to USD 53).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Carnelian?

The best way to check the authenticity of Carnelian is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Carnelian are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Carnelian carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Carnelian is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Carnelian have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Carnelian, but if you find flaws, then your Carnelian is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Carnelian are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Carnelian. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Carnelian, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Carnelian from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Carnelian. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Carnelian. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Carnelian Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Warm soapy water and a soft cloth are the most effective cleaning agents for carnelians.

After washing the gemstone, it must be dried and stored with care. Ultrasonic cleaners can cause cracks and chips, so you should avoid using them.
